claims.claim: Every turf product we install is PFAS-free
claims.receipt_needed: Supplier PFAS test documents for each product NoCo installs today. Colorado SB24-081: no artificial turf with intentionally added PFAS may be installed on or after 2026-01-01 (https://leg.colorado.gov/bills/sb24-081, checked 2026-09-24). Research found the former supplier publishes a PFAS test claim for its imported products (Nov 2023) — Brian confirms current products and supplier (Appendix A #6).
aliases: all of our turf is pfas-free
claims.note: The law applies to everyone; this entry covers only the claim that NoCo's own products comply.
